reason: Classified as a web interface theme plugin because the package name, description, manifest, and README consistently identify it as a DeepSeek Harness skin that applies Rhine Lab-style visuals through client-side stylesheet and token overrides, with a setting hook for enable/disable; there is no repository evidence of non-UI integrations, data processing pipelines, or external service connectivity.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的主题插件，用于应用莱茵生命风格的界面外观，同时沿用现有的设置与交互入口。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness Web GUI plugin that applies a Rhine Lab style theme to the interface while keeping existing controls and settings flow.

capabilities: DeepSeek Harness web theme installation via DSH bundle patch
Custom style and token injection for UI appearance
Theme preference registration in the web client settings
Provides an optional lightweight visual skin without introducing new workflow actions
